stages.title: Build
stages.subtitle: Three designers build the 12 carousels in parallel, four posts each, then fix them by eye.
stages.action: Nothing yet. Per your Batch 2 rule, everything gets built first; you review the finished slides at the end.
stages.report:
### What's happening
- **Intake (done):** the 12 final posts, verbatim from your edit file, in posting order.
- **Direction + art direction (done):** slide 1 and the whole post on deep or night (the data: light grounds 0 of 10); gold only for the end slide. Same cut-paper through-line. **12 new compositions**, none from Batch 1–2 (see each card below). Full spec: `app/art_direction_b3.md`.
- **Build (working now):** each designer renders, reads the contact sheet, and fixes until the kit's checks pass: your words verbatim, no line ending in a comma, no text under 44px, nothing crossing the art.
- **Next:** Creative QA scores every post (Arabic legibility is a gate), then you get one zip per post in posting order.

### The contact sheets below are work in progress
They update each time I republish this board. Slide 1 is at the top-right; read right to left.

b3p3.composition: Low conveyor band: the checkout belt across the lower third; the full trolley left behind; a race of small vs big hands loading the belt. Ground: deep.

b3p11.composition: Wall-tile grid macro: one big wall dryer with gold sound arcs; wet hands over small ears. Ground: night.

b3p1.composition: Doorway glow: the majlis door pouring gold light into a dark corridor; the two-squeeze hands. Ground: deep.

b3p5.composition: Split pair: the cracked biscuit beside a phone with the same crack. Ground: night.

b3p2.composition: Cut-away house: the big majlis next to the small side room. Ground: night.

b3p12.composition: Coat-hook rail: his jacket carried, then hung low beside your abaya. Ground: deep.

b3p10.composition: Torch cone: the phone flash cutting through the dark onto a small hand; then your own nail first. Ground: night (the «ما تقدري … إلا» test).

b3p6.composition: Vertical stack hero: one tall block tower, then the box with raised edges. Ground: deep.

b3p8.composition: Kiddie ride on a tiled mall floor (no face, no headlight eyes). Ground: night.

b3p9.composition: High shelf: the packet on top of the wardrobe, a small hand reaching; then the prepared activity. Ground: deep.

b3p4.composition: Order screen of blank tiles (one glowing) + a curling receipt; no waiter. Ground: night.

b3p7.composition: Fanned paper cards (no numbers), tossed, then stacked in a box. Ground: deep.
